messages:
maya: Quick design sync — protos attached. Need final call on three things: streaming visuals (inline bubble vs rail), stop/regen affordance, and where the token counter lives. Also minor a11y nits.

trent: Uploaded screens: https://figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-bubble-vs-rail - two variants. Bubble shows streaming text inside a rounded bubble with an inline token badge top-right. Rail puts a compact live stream with full token meter in the right rail.

jen: quick accessibility notes before we pick:
- streaming updates must be in an aria-live region (polite) so screen readers get partial updates, not repeated focus jumps.
- stop button needs keyboard focus + visible focus ring.
- color contrast on token badge is failing at small sizes (needs 4.5:1 for text)

sam: agree on contrast. Also think token counter should be visible during the stream but not distract. Maybe collapsed to an icon that expands on hover/focus.

maya: UX tradeoffs: bubble = conversational feel, lower visual weight. Rail = more analytics-friendly (you can see token trend). Product wants low friction for devs shipping demos; leaning bubble. Thoughts?

trent: Bubble variant has two micro-patterns:
A) Inline token badge: small pill with count and tooltip on hover. Stops/regen are two separate buttons (stop, regenerate) aligned to message.
B) Combined interrupt control: single affordance that toggles between Stop (while streaming) and Regenerate (after finished). Long-press reveals 'Regenerate with edited prompt' modal.

jen: I prefer separate explicit controls for accessibility/readability. Single toggling control is harder to discover and keyboard users may not find long-press. Also long-press is not keyboard-friendly.

sam: +1. Separate buttons give clearer semantics and allow distinct aria-labels: `Stop generation` vs `Regenerate response`.

maya: Okay separate for clarity. Minor proposal: make Stop primary during stream, Regen disabled (aria-disabled) until stream ends. Regen has tooltip: "Regenerate response with same prompt".

trent: Looks good. For the token counter placement I sketched an inline badge that becomes a small meter in the composer footer when you open the tokens panel. That keeps the message UI clean.

jen: That helps. A few a11y specifics:
- token badge should have `role=status` and `aria-live="off"` so it doesn't spam SR reads but is announced when it changes significantly (we can use `aria-atomic=true` for bursts).
- ensure token meter in footer has label `Tokens used` and keyboard shortcut tooltip `T` in the help menu.

sam: Microcopy: instead of "Tokens used" maybe "Model tokens" or "Prompt + output tokens"? Need clarity for billing. Product prefers shorter: "Tokens" and hover details show breakdown.

maya: Product ok with "Tokens" + hover breakdown. Also need copy for stop/regenerate tooltips. Suggested: Stop -> "Stop generation (Esc)"; Regenerate -> "Regenerate response".

trent: Quick CSS snippet if we go bubble + inline badge:```css
.token-badge{background:#0F172A;color:#fff;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px}
.token-badge:focus{outline:3px solid #7DD3FC}
```

jen: color `#0F172A` on `#fff` is okay but on small text size test contrast. If we use gray backgrounds in dark mode we may need a semi-bold font to pass AA.

maya: Accessibility TODOs: update aria attributes, keyboard focus states, tooltip labels, and run VoiceOver + NVDA pass. I'll own this.

sam: Quick question on streaming animation: do we animate per-chunk fade-in or append instantly? Animations need to be disabled when `prefers-reduced-motion` is set.

trent: I prototyped per-chunk slide-and-fade. But will add `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` fallback to instant append.

maya: Good. Another small decision: should stop also cancel server-side streaming (yes), and we should expose a `stopReason` tag in logs: `user_cancel` vs `timeout` for analytics. Can eng add that?

ui-bot: deploy-bot: Noted — backend event `generation_stop` will accept `reason`. Example payload: {"reason":"user_cancel","thread_id":"${thread_ts}"}.

jen: Last nit: keyboard order. Ensure Stop is before Regenerate in DOM when streaming (so it's one tab stop away) and when finished Regen becomes tabbable.

sam: vote: bubble + inline badge + separate buttons + tokens in footer. :thumbsup:

trent: I can polish mocks and hand off updated figma. Will also add an alt state for low-contrast mode and a11y annotations.

maya: Plan: ship bubble baseline to beta, run NVDA/VoiceOver pass, then evaluate rail if customers ask for token telemetry. I'll write a short spec and copy for tooltips. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:

jen: leaving some inline comments in the figma.

sam: can someone add keyboard shortcut doc to /docs/playground/shortcuts.md? I'll stub it after the spec.

maya: Added to my action items. End of thread.
